charts.title: Clean power-off lift limit with load factor
charts.note: 12,500 lb, BuNo 80765. The measured 1 g CAS anchors the curve. Exact stall pressure altitude is unreported. The projected values describe lift onset, with the same airframe and power-off configuration.

series.label: BuNo 80765, clean power off
series.limits: CAS → EAS → load scaling → CAS at the same ISA pressure altitude. Central case 2,500 ft, bracket 0–5,000 ft. Transfer of effective maximum lift is varied up to ±5% from 2 g onward.

charts.title: Clean power-off stall with gross weight
charts.note: 43-24777, 86 mph indicated at 9,270 lb, oil and coolant shutters closed. Target weights are scenario loads. The powered and open-shutter tests are separate.

charts.title: Power-off clean and landing lift envelopes
charts.note: NACA’s fuel-corrected normal-force coefficients for BuAer 04776. Gross weights bracket Part I’s reported test loading range. The chart holds coefficient and geometry fixed inside each envelope. CG varied in the source loads.

series.label: clean-glide at 1 g
series.limits: Normal-force coefficient used as an effective lift coefficient at 1 g, with a 334 ft² wing. The band spans NACA’s stated coefficient range. These are calculated EAS values at target masses.

series.label: landing at 1 g

series.label: Fixed geometry, conditional indicated-speed scaling

series.label: Open flaps, digitized source then calculated tail

charts.note: 3,000 rpm, 4,300 kg departure, ETC 504, intake-side flap flush and others open. Through 8,000 m only. The 9,000 m radiator setting change and the 4,100 kg level run are separate conditions.

series.label: Integrated climb rates
